# Apply progress: issue-473 — Slice 1 (PR1, parser extraction)

Change: issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff. Branch: feat/issue-473-s1-parser-extraction (targets tracker branch feat/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff, feature-branch-chain). Batch: FIRST (no prior apply-progress existed).

## Scope this batch
Phase 1 / Slice 1 ONLY (parser extraction) — 9 tasks from `sdd/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/tasks` (#2726). Phase 2 (actor-check reader) and Phase 3 (brain:approve CLI + ADR draft) are OUT OF SCOPE for this batch — not started.

## Completed Tasks (Phase 1 — all 9 done)
- [x] 1.1 RED — decision-block.test.mjs written against a module that did not exist (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) — confirmed red via `node --test`.
- [x] 1.2 GREEN — created decision-block.mjs with its OWN inline copy of FENCE_RE/scalar (deliberately independent implementation, not copy-pasted from parse-verdict.mjs) — minimal render/parse.
- [x] 1.3 RED — round-trip test (parseDecision(renderDecision(x)) returns every E1 field) — included in the same initial red batch (compressed with 1.1; see Deviations).
- [x] 1.4 GREEN — implemented full E1 field set (protocol, decision, head_sha, actor, at, in_reply_to).
- [x] 1.5 RED — one test per E2 parse-level rule (3,4,5,6,7,8,9,12,17,18,19,20) — included in the same initial red batch.
- [x] 1.6 GREEN — implemented remaining field validation (protocol exact match, decision exact literal, head_sha 40-hex regex, actor presence, first-fence-only via non-global FENCE_RE, at/in_reply_to pass-through-when-present).
- [x] 1.7 RED — yaml-block.drift.test.mjs written; 2 of 7 rows genuinely failed pre-extraction ("yaml-tagged fence with trailing space before newline", "CRLF line endings throughout body") because decision-block.mjs's independently-written FENCE_RE (`` ```(?:yaml)?\n `` — no `\s*` tolerance) diverged from parse-verdict.mjs's proven one (`` ```(?:yaml)?\s*\n ``). Confirmed via real `node --test` run, not asserted.
- [x] 1.8 GREEN — extracted yaml-block.mjs (FENCE_RE, extractFencedBlock, scalar, decodeYamlEscapes, unyamlScalar, parseJsonScalar) from parse-verdict.mjs verbatim; parse-verdict.mjs now imports these instead of defining them; decision-block.mjs now imports the same shared primitives, deleting its divergent inline copy. All 7 drift rows green after this step.
- [x] 1.9 Verify — parse-verdict.mjs's two-protocol allowlist (`proto !== 'brain-review/1' && proto !== 'brain-review/2'`) unchanged; full suite green; `git diff --stat brain/scripts/review/lib/parse-verdict.test.mjs` confirmed EMPTY (zero-line diff) — parse-verdict.test.mjs was never touched.

## TDD Cycle Evidence

| Task | RED | GREEN | REFACTOR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1/1.3/1.5 (compressed) | module-not-found, then 16 assertions failing pre-implementation — verified via `node --test brain/scripts/review/lib/decision-block.test.mjs` | 1.2/1.4/1.6 combined implementation — 16/16 pass | n/a |
| 1.7 | yaml-block.drift.test.mjs: 2/7 rows red (fence-trailing-space, CRLF) — verified via `node --test` | 1.8 extraction — 7/7 rows green | n/a |
| 1.9 | n/a (verification task) | full suite 2738/2738 green; parse-verdict.test.mjs diff = 0 lines | n/a |

## Mutation / red-proof evidence (drift guard + purity guard)
Per red-proof-blind-along-an-unvaried-axis.md doctrine — proved BOTH guards bite via live mutation, not just "should":
1. **yaml-block.drift.test.mjs** (axis: SPELLING/logic — re-inlined a divergent copy): temporarily restored decision-block.mjs's old inline FENCE_RE/scalar (bypassing the shared import) → 2/7 rows went red (same two rows as pre-extraction) → reverted → 7/7 green again. Confirms the guard is not vacuously true.
2. **parse-verdict.test.mjs purity guard** (axis: protocol allowlist mutation): temporarily changed `proto !== 'brain-review/1' && proto !== 'brain-review/2'` to `proto !== 'brain-review/1'` (dropping /2 support) → 17/33 parse-verdict.test.mjs tests went red → reverted → 33/33 green again. Confirms the "zero-diff = pure move" claim is load-bearing, not decorative.

Both mutations reverted; working tree confirmed clean via `git diff --stat` (empty) before commit.

## Commits
- `cf1c63f` — `refactor(review): extract shared fenced-YAML primitives into yaml-block.mjs (#473)` — single work unit, all 5 files (yaml-block.mjs new, decision-block.mjs new, decision-block.test.mjs new, yaml-block.drift.test.mjs new, parse-verdict.mjs edited). Gate-counted changed lines: ~249 (matches tasks forecast ~250 for slice 1). Commit-msg hook passed.

## Gates (all green)
- `npm test` (full incl. e2e): 2750/2750 pass, 0 fail.
- `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs"`: 2738/2738 pass (baseline was 2715; +23 new tests: 16 decision-block.test.mjs + 7 yaml-block.drift.test.mjs).
- `npm run repo:check`: pass ("No prohibited references found", "Artifact structure is valid").
- `npm run brain:nav`: pass ("Navegación de brain/ íntegra: sin huérfanos, sin links rotos").

## Deviations from design/tasks (reported, not silently accommodated)
1. **RED steps compressed**: tasks 1.1/1.3/1.5 were each supposed to be shown red independently before their paired GREEN (1.2/1.4/1.6). I wrote the full decision-block.test.mjs (all 16 cases covering 1.1+1.3+1.5) in one file, confirmed a genuine RED (module-not-found) for the whole file, then implemented the full parseDecision/renderDecision (covering 1.2+1.4+1.6) in one GREEN pass, confirmed 16/16 green. This is a real RED→GREEN transition, but coarser-grained than the task list's per-field choreography. Root cause: task 1.1's RED (module missing) makes it impossible to show finer-grained reds for 1.3/1.5 without an intermediate partial-implementation checkpoint I judged not worth the extra round-trips given the tests were straightforward and independently verifiable. Flagging for verify phase to confirm this is acceptable.
2. **B3 guard row selection**: design named 9 pathological rows including "quoted value with \\, \", \n,  " and "a value containing a #". I dropped these two because decision-block.mjs's fields (protocol, decision, head_sha, actor, at, in_reply_to) are all read via plain `scalar()`, which never calls `decodeYamlEscapes`/`unyamlScalar` (those are only invoked for findings/follow_ups/sequencing, none of which exist in the decision protocol). Testing quoted/escaped values against head_sha would exercise each protocol's OWN validation asymmetry (parseDecision's strict 40-hex format check vs parseVerdict's absence of format checking) rather than the SHARED primitive's behavior — which would produce a permanent, by-design "divergence" that could never go green post-extraction, breaking the guard's purpose. Implemented 7 rows instead (no fence, bare-tag fence, yaml-tag+trailing-space, CRLF, tab-indented key, empty block, two-fences-first-wins) — 2 of which produced genuine pre-extraction divergence.
3. **HEAD_SHA_RE case sensitivity**: implemented as `/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i` (case-insensitive) per design E2 note "Comparisons: head_sha case-folded (hex case is not identity)" — this is a parse-level FORMAT check only (accepts both ABCDEF and abcdef as valid hex), not a comparison against the actual PR head SHA (that comparison is Phase 2's job, per design). Documenting since the task list doesn't spell out the regex explicitly.

## Remaining Tasks (NOT done — future batches)
- [ ] Phase 2 (PR2) — actor-check reader: tasks 2.1-2.11, `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs` (edit), `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs` (extend). Depends on this slice's decision-block.mjs (parseDecision) — dependency satisfied, ready to start.
- [ ] Phase 3 (PR3) — brain:approve CLI + ADR-0026 Amendment 2 draft: tasks 3.1-3.17, plus package.json wiring. Depends on Phase 1 (renderDecision, done) and Phase 2 (not yet done).
- [ ] H.1, H.2 — human-only follow-up, not agent work.

## Workload / PR Boundary
- Mode: chained PR slice (feature-branch-chain), per orchestrator's stated delivery_strategy/chain_strategy for this session.
- Current work unit: Slice 1 (parser extraction) — PR1 of 3, targets tracker branch `feat/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff`.
- Boundary: starts from main/tracker HEAD, ends at commit cf1c63f. Independently revertible (no other slice depends on runtime behavior changes here — parse-verdict.mjs's public behavior is provably unchanged).
- Estimated review budget impact: ~249 gate-counted lines, ~474 full-diff lines (incl. 2 new test files) — matches tasks forecast (~250 gate / ~540 full). Reviewable in well under 60 minutes.

## Status
9/9 Phase 1 tasks complete. Slice 1 done. Not yet pushed, no PR opened (per instructions — orchestrator handles push/PR). Ready for sdd-verify on this slice, or sdd-apply again for Phase 2.
